thread:
alex (PM): sharing a quick design pass for the request drilldown — want a fast read on export placement + copy + keyboard flow. screenshot: https://files.redwood/test/drilldown-v3.png

maya (Design): saw it, nice density improvements. my main worry is the export button sitting between correlation info and the timeline. feels like a visual interrupt.

sam (Eng): fwiw the current export triggers a server job that can take a few seconds. if it sits near interactive elements users will click it accidentally during quick copy actions.

alex (PM): good point. options: 1) move export into kebab (•••) menu, 2) keep visible but add confirmation toast, 3) make it a secondary action tucked to the right. thoughts?

maya (Design): leaning to kebab for now. keeps primary actions (Copy ID / Jump to span) visible and reduces accidental exports.

derek (DevEx): agree. also accessibility note: if it's in kebab, ensure the menu is reachable via keyboard (Enter/Space to open, arrows to navigate). current kebab component doesn't trap focus correctly.

lio (QA): reproduction steps: keyboard nav on Mac + VoiceOver — after opening kebab, focus lands on the first item then immediately returns to the main content. failing on both Safari and Chrome.

sam (Eng): thanks — will add a fix. quick aria suggestion for copy button: use aria-label="Copy trace ID" rather than just "Copy" so screenreaders get context. also announce a toast like "Trace ID copied to clipboard" that is injected with role="status".

maya (Design): copy tweaks: replace "Copy ID" with "Copy trace ID" in the button, and tooltip should read "Copy the trace identifier for linking to support" (shorter preferred).

alex (PM): what about the correlation ID display itself — should the ID and the copy be in the same row or split into a lighter secondary line? current feels cramped.

maya (Design): put the long hex ID on its own muted line under the header, with inline copy and fingerprint icon on the right. reduces visual clutter and improves scan.

derek (DevEx): small code snippet for aria I propose: `button.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Copy trace ID')` and `toast.setAttribute('role', 'status')`. Also keyboard shortcut: `⌘/Ctrl+Shift+C` to copy current trace — discussed earlier, we should mention in tooltip.

lio (QA): acceptance criteria from QA: 1) export item reachable via keyboard in kebab, 2) copy button has aria-label and toast announced, 3) screen reader reads "Trace ID copied" (no raw hex read aloud by default), 4) focus returns to the element that opened the menu after closing.

sam (Eng): will implement focus trap + return, aria labels, and kebab export move. note: export will now run asynchronously — adding a progress spinner inside the kebab item so user knows it's working.

maya (Design): UX nit for spinner: make it 12px and use medium-contrast stroke. tooltip when running should read "Preparing export…" not just "Working".

alex (PM): copy to ship checklist: design copy updated, dev to add aria and kbd nav, QA tests added. target for next patch deploy. any objection?

lio (QA): none from me, will queue tests.

sam (Eng): no objections. I'll pair with Derek on the focus trap tomorrow.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: patch/trace-drilldown-export-a11y -> staging (build 2026.03.19-89) :rocket:

maya (Design): tiny follow-up — when the export completes we display a link to the exported file. link text should be "Download trace export" instead of just "Download" so it’s clear in shared screenshots.

alex (PM): noted. thanks everyone, will send PR with the copy changes to the design tokens doc and add QA checklist to the ticket. :thumbsup:
